x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Emva kokuba iphumlise intetho yakhe kwaye immemile ukuba aphumle, ukuqina kuya kuvakala kukude.

x-k-k8-04.s.s2.prompt: NgesiNgesi: kwinxalenye yokuqala, ubunokukwazi ukuthi ngubani omdala? Chaza ongakwazi nokungakwazi ukukuqikelela, nolwazi owalufunayo. Cela ubuncinane isicatshulwa esinye sesiKorean.

x-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko jonga ukuba ngumgca onjani wenxalenye 3 onika inyani elahlekileyo.

x-k-k8-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ingcamango yam yokuqala yahlukile kwimbono yam yokugqibela, kwaye ndichazile isizathu?
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.model.0: Hayi. Kwi-안녕하세요 nakwi-반가워요 bobabini basebenzise intetho ehloniphekileyo, ngoko yabonisa kuphela ukuba abazani. Bendifuna ubudala okanye isihloko; ndifunde kwi-98년생 nakwi-96 kwinxalenye yokugqibela.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.model.1: Bendingakwazi ukuthi. 하린 wathi 반가워요 yaye 선우 wathi 입사한 선우입니다, oku kuhloniphekile kodwa kulinganayo. Iminyaka yokuzalwa kuphela kwinxalenye yokugqibela eyabonisa ukuba ngubani omdala.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.model.2: Kwinxalenye 1 bobabini basebenzise intetho ehloniphekileyo (안녕하세요, 반가워요), ngoko ndandingakwazi ukuthi ngubani omdala. Bendifuna ubudala babo; ndabufumana kwi-98년생 nakwi-96 kamva.

x-k-k8-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma ukuba utitshala wenza bani enze isenzo, kwaye lo mntu wenza ntoni.
x-k-k8-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kwisivakalisi sokwenzeka, khetha into eyenzeka kwiposta okanye kwigumbi njengesiphumo.
x-k-k8-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba kucacile ukuba nguye 지수 hayi utitshala owenza isenzo kwi-(1)?
x-k-k8-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba i-(2) ichaza isiphumo esihambelana nomfanekiso ofanayo?

x-k-k8-05.title: Isidlo sangokuhlwa silungile: Ugogo nomntakwenu omncinci
x-k-k8-05.goal: Chaza umyalezo ofanayo kwigogo nakumzala omncinci ngokutshintsha izibizo, izenzi, iziphelo nophawu lwesihloko.
x-k-k8-05.material: Uhlala nogogo wakho (할머니) nomntakwenu oneminyaka eyi-8 (동생). Isidlo sangokuhlwa silungile etafileni. Ufuna ukuxelela ngamnye: 'Isidlo sangokuhlwa sisetafileni. Nceda uze utye.' Kumntakwenu wongeza nokuthi: 'Hlamba izandla kuqala.'
x-k-k8-05.thinking.0: Ukugqiba ukuba ziziphi iinxalenye zomyalezo ezixhomekeke kumphulaphuli
x-k-k8-05.thinking.1: Ukuvelisa iinguqulelo zembeko neziqhelekileyo zomxholo ofanayo
x-k-k8-05.prereq.0: Uyazi ukuba isiKorean sinefom zembeko neziqhelekileyo zezibizo, izenzi neziphelo
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.prompt: Ziziphi iinxalenye zomyalezo ekufuneka zitshintshe xa uguqula umyalezo womntakwenu ube ngowogogo? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ngawaphi amagama achaza into ekumphulaphuli okanye eyenziwa ngumphulaphuli?
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola inketho nganye: ngaba enye ifom inomlingane okhethekileyo wembeko?
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.r.c: Omabini la magama ngezinto ezingathathi cala; ukubini kwembeko kusebenza ekutyeni nasezenzweni zomntu.
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.explain: Isidlo nesenzo sokutya zezomphulaphuli, ngoko zithatha iifom zembeko (진지, 드시다). Izinto ezingathathi cala namagama exesha ziyahlala zinjalo.
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ngesiKorean oko ukuthethayo kugogo wakho: isidlo sangokuhlwa silungile etafileni; nceda uze utye.
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ngawaphi amagama amabini kwinguqulelo yomntakwenu afuna ifom ekhethekileyo yegogo?
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha isiphelo esicela ngembeko endaweni yokwalela.
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ndisebenzise igama lembeko kwisidlo okanye ekutyeni, hayi nje -요 ehloniphekileyo?
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isivakalisi sisicelo esivakala sifudumele, hayi umyalelo?
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku bhala ngesiKorean oko ukuthethayo komntakwenu oneminyaka eyi-8: hlamba izandla kuqala, uze ufike utye.
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.0: Zeziphi izenzi ozidingayo kwezi zenzo zimbini?
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.1: Iziphelo ezingekho sikweni zihlala ziphela nge -어, -아 okanye -자.
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba zomibini izenzo ziyavela ngocwangco olululo?
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba intetho ayikho sikweni ngokucacileyo kodwa isenobubele?
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba umntwana oneminyaka eyi-8 angayiqonda kwangoko?
